# Extract all results for use in GSEA ?

> Example from Xu et al. 2024:
> `all_results <- lapply(time_points, function(time_point) { 
 result <- results(dds, tidy = TRUE, 
 contrast = c("group", time_point, "0h")) 
 setNames(object = result$log2FoldChange, nm = result$row) |>   sort(decreasing = TRUE)` 


```{r}
leachate_levels <- setdiff(levels(metadata_or$leachate), "control")

all_results <- lapply(leachate_levels, function(lvl) { 
  res <- results(
    dds,
    tidy     = TRUE,
    contrast = c("leachate", lvl, "control")  # <— uses leachate, not group
  )
  
  setNames(object = res$log2FoldChange, nm = res$row) |>
    sort(decreasing = TRUE)
})
names(all_results) <- leachate_levels

```
